title: Scheduled upgrade tiers, optional accelerated upgrades, and security questionnaire playbook
creator: Dana Ortiz
description: Summary: Define and experiment on a two-axis packaging approach for Private/VPC/on-prem customers: (1) tiered scheduled upgrade cadence + optional accelerated upgrade add-on, and (2) explicit support SLA tiers paired with a streamlined security-questionnaire (SQ) playbook that reduces legal procurement friction. Goal: reduce contract cycle time, increase incremental ARR from accelerated-upgrade add-ons, and provide clear operational expectations for enterprise customers.
background: We have recurring asks from enterprise customers for: fixed maintenance windows, predictable upgrade timelines for validated on-prem images, and the option to pay for faster security/upgrade turnarounds. Sales/legal have flagged long SQ review times as a principal deal blocker for private deployments. This experiment couples pricing changes with a practical SQ response process so both procurement friction and product ops load are measured.
hypothesis: If we offer three scheduled upgrade cadences (Quarterly, Monthly, Accelerated) with a paid accelerated tier and pair that with a templated SQ playbook + dedicated intake SLA, then (a) average contract negotiation time for Private deals will fall by 30%, (b) 10-15% of qualified on-prem customers will opt into accelerated upgrades in year one, and (c) platform ops cost per-deployment remains within 10% of baseline.
experiment_design: Variants: A) Baseline (Quarterly upgrades, standard support), B) Tiered (Quarterly/Monthly/Accelerated with list prices), C) Hybrid pilot (Tiered + discounted accelerated first-year). Pricing examples (pilot): base license $120k/year for N GPUs up to 8, monthly cadence +$15k/yr, accelerated +$45k/yr. Support tiers: Standard (48h P1), Premium (8h P1), Premium+ (2h P1 + dedicated technical lead). Offer a 30-day trial of accelerated cadence for early adopters. Measure opt-in %, deal close delta, ops incidents, and time-to-SQ-complete.
success_metrics: Net new ARR from accelerated add-ons >= $500k in 12 months
playbook_components: 1) SQ intake form (pre-populated template) 2) Pre-approved security answers and redline guidance 3) Legal & Security SLA: 7/14/30 day tiers depending on risk 4) Technical checklist for upgrade windows and rollback plan 5) Pricing matrix and approval thresholds 6) Standard clause language for accelerated upgrades
operational_impact: Engineering effort: automated packaging for Monthly/Accelerated channels, additional E2E test gating (+2 engineer sprints). Support: defined runbook for accelerated deploys and on-call rotation changes. Legal: prepare clause library and delegation matrix. Customer Success: onboarding materials and upgrade calendar UI in console.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: accelerated cadence increases regressions and ops load. Mitigation: limit accelerated to customers meeting baseline telemetry thresholds and require extra staging window. Risk: customers expect unlimited rollback windows. Mitigation: define SLAs and charge for emergency rollbacks. Risk: legal pushback on fixed cadence as warranty. Mitigation: create modular contract language and sign-off checklist.
